lines.text: They placed the ark inside David's tent, and David gave every man and woman bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.
David appointed Levites to minister before the ark, with Asaph on cymbals and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel on trumpets.
God made a covenant with Abraham, swore an oath to Isaac, and promised Israel the land of Egypt.
While Israel's forefathers wandered, God rebuked priests for them, saying, "Do not touch My anointed ones!"
David left Zadok and his fellow priests at the Gibeon high place to present burnt offerings morning and evening.
